errors.evidence: The Semantic Layer is medium blue, not light bluish-gray.
The Signal Layer is light purple, not medium blue.
The Cultural Layer is light grey, not light gray.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart represents different analytical layers in a study of content analysis.
The description does not mention that the chart includes percentage labels within the slices for the inner slices only.
The description does not mention that the center part of the chart is white.

errors.text_span: In the outer ring, the Semantic Layer is split into Content Analysis (a very large light bluish-gray arc), Emotion & Intention (smaller light bluish-gray arc), and Speaker Analysis (small light bluish-gray arc); the Perception Layer is split into Environmental Perception & Reasoning (large dark-blue arc), Counting & Statistics (large dark-blue arc), Music Theory (medium dark-blue arc), Correlation Analysis (medium dark-blue arc), Temporal Analysis (small dark-blue arc), and Spatial Analysis (very small dark-blue arc); the Cultural Layer is split into Professional Knowl. & Reasoning (large light-gray arc), Culture of Speaker (medium light-gray arc), Imagination (small light-gray arc), and Aesthetic Analysis (very small light-gray arc); and the Signal Layer is split into Anomaly Detection (small medium-blue arc), Acoustic Quality Analysis (very small medium-blue arc), and Audio Difference Analysis (a tiny medium-blue sliver).
errors.evidence: The description is excessively detailed in describing the size of each arc, which is unnecessary and detracts from readability.
